title: Lantronix CEO to Meet with Investors and Defense Customers at AUSA 2026
body_markdown:
October 7, 2026


# Lantronix CEO to Meet with Investors and Defense Customers at AUSA 2026


*CEO Saleel Awsare to discuss unmanned systems revenue growth, the company’s Blue UAS listing and its move up the value chain in defense unmanned systems*


**IRVINE, Calif., Oct. 7, 2026 –**[Lantronix Inc.](https://www.lantronix.com/) (Nasdaq: LTRX), a global provider of Edge AI and Industrial IoT solutions that power NDAA-compliant unmanned systems, critical infrastructure and resilient enterprise networks, today announced that President and CEO Saleel Awsare will attend the


[Association of the U.S. Army (AUSA) 2026 Annual Meeting and Exposition](https://meetings.ausa.org/annual/2026/index.cfm) , Oct. 12–14 at the Walter E. Washington Convention Center in Washington, D.C., where he will hold meetings with investors, defense customers and partners.


“Our unmanned systems business went from a minimal contribution to $12.6 million in revenue in fiscal 2026, and customers are now asking for more than a compute module,” said Saleel Awsare, president and CEO of Lantronix. “That demand is moving Lantronix up the value chain toward integrated edge AI for autonomous systems, and AUSA puts us in front of the defense customers and partners driving it.”


**Discussion topics will include:**


- Unmanned systems revenue of $12.6 million in fiscal 2026, up from a minimal contribution in fiscal 2025


- The recent


[Blue UAS Framework](https://www.lantronix.com/newsroom/press-releases/lantronix-secures-blue-uas-companion-computer-som-listing-expanding-defense-drone-opportunity/) listing of the Open-Q™ 8550CS System-on-Module, expanding access to U.S. defense and government programs


- Demand tied to the Department of War’s $1.1 billion Drone Dominance Program, Europe and beyond-visual-line-of-sight (BVLOS) markets


- Over 30 active engagements across defense, commercial, public safety and counter-UAS, with customers and partners including Sightline, AVT Australia, Swarmer and Unusual Machines


Investors interested in meeting with Lantronix during AUSA should contact Gateway Group at


[\[email protected\]](https://www.lantronix.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#632f37313b230402170614021a4e0411134d000c0e) .


**About Lantronix**


Lantronix Inc. (Nasdaq: LTRX) is a global leader in Edge AI and Industrial IoT solutions that power NDAA-compliant unmanned systems, critical infrastructure and resilient enterprise networks. It delivers intelligent computing, secure connectivity and remote management for mission-critical applications, enabling customers to optimize operations, enhance security and accelerate digital transformation. Its comprehensive portfolio of hardware, software and services powers applications ranging from mission-critical autonomous platforms and edge analytics for critical infrastructure to intelligent surveillance and secure network management. By bringing intelligence to the network edge, Lantronix helps organizations achieve efficiency, security and a competitive edge in today’s AI-driven world. For more information, visit the


[Lantronix website](https://www.lantronix.com/) .
